titles: The New Bantam-Megiddo Hebrew & English Dictionary

Mixed languages: English, Spanish (Larousse, Alemán, Gramática de la lengua guatusa), French (Le Robert), Hebrew and Georgian script on two spines. Left out: the red spine at the far right of the top shelf cut by the frame ('Dic... Le... Esp...'), the two thin red and light-blue spines left of the Arabic dictionary and the tall purple Chinese book behind the grammar (text too small or hidden), the dark blue Croatian-English spine (Hrvatsko-engleski, title not fully legible), the orange 'Conversemos en ...' spine, the Georgian-script spine, and the red pocket dictionary cut by the right edge.
